name: Rosemary
description: Rosemary is an evergreen Mediterranean shrub with needle-like leaves.
usefulInformation: Pairs well with roasted vegetables, focaccia and infused oil.
healthBenefits: Provides aromatic compounds and antioxidants, but culinary use is not proven to treat disease.
medicinalUses: Traditionally used in aromatic preparations; concentrated oils require care.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
